definitions.explanation: A place at a distance or on the opposite side.
The person or people on the other side of an interaction.

examples.japanese: {向こう|むこう}に{山|やま}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see a mountain over there.

examples.japanese: {橋|はし}の{向こう|むこう}に{公園|こうえん}がある。
examples.english: There's a park on the other side of the bridge.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{向こう|むこう}に{島|しま}が{見|み}えるので、{今度|こんど}{行|い}ってみたい。
examples.english: I can see an island across the sea, and I'd like to visit it sometime.

examples.japanese: {向こう|むこう}から{連絡|れんらく}があった。
{向こう|むこう}の{意見|いけん}も{聞|き}いてみよう。
examples.english: Let's also hear what the other party has to say.

examples.japanese: {向こう|むこう}が{先|さき}に{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}ったので、こちらも{契約|けいやく}を{解除|かいじょ}した。
examples.english: The other party broke the agreement first, so we also canceled the contract.

notes: Can refer to physical locations or the other party in communications.
